source.classification: Previously exposed fully specified synthetic repository fixture; not an independently authored or unfamiliar textbook question

purpose: Teacher-directed physical and numerical exploration of one immutable source-backed optical scene; no requirement to reproduce a textbook answer.
interpretation: Use the previous fully source-matched minimal authoring request. Do not reauthor the baseline or populate missing physical facts. Each intervention below is a teacher-proposed hypothesis, not an original given.
approvedScope: Reuse existing qualified-scene snapshots, reviseScene for stable-ID field edits, canonical validate for structural scene tests, passive observations, and runParameterSweep.
All accepted scenarios trace actual pinned native PhyDemo and carry their own scene hash and source-linked qualification.
Comparison does not change the physical model or certify identical units, sampling or assumptions without explicit checks.
No provider inference, new production physics, generic scenario patch schema, LLM first-attempt benchmark, human learning claim or public site.

investigations.description: Run source-backed baseline with already registered optional readouts; no teaching hypothetical.
Run the unchanged baseline with one additional existing explicit observable; never replace the apparatus.

investigations.expected: Physical lens behavior and ideal-image prediction should respond; aggregate sampled counts need not.
Object distance changes and native rays must be retraced. No dynamic travel or new initial condition equation is implied.
Apparatus and ideal-image prediction must remain the same. Sample counts and relative brightness readings may change; explicitly check source clipping before physical comparisons.

Only the new passive detector and its new observation are added. The existing public reviseScene API does not support structural edits; canonical cloned-scene validation is an evaluation-only route, not a claimed public minimal patch interface.
Viewport changes; no optical or sampling changes, but current-report hashes must still bind to this scene revision.

negativeControls.expected: Reject, no native calls and no partial baseline mutation.
Reject detector/lens contact without moving an existing component or inventing a new location.

sweep.expected: Each value branches from same baseline; invalid f=0 is a retained failed sample, not a repaired plot point.

comparisonRules: Same physical readout only when target identity, method, units, accepted status, model and compatible numerical settings are established.
A physical parameter change should be distinguishable from numerical sampling and from presentation edits.
Do not interpret sampled counts as continuous flux or signed relative power as watts.
Sampling differences including brightness clipping are not automatically physical illumination differences.
An additional detector has no baseline counterpart and must not be compared as though it did.
Any conditional image location is a model equation prediction and not a native image detection.
stopConditions: Do not modify pinned upstream, production optical laws, public scene schema, source fixture or historical frozen attempts.
Do not silently replace missing physical facts or assume a structural proposal is supported by the targeted public revision API.
Treat the experiment as deterministic software qualification, not independent LLM authoring or educational effectiveness.
Keep new PR draft and unmerged for separate approval.
